headline: Revenue and profit surge, margins widen year-over-year
summary_short: Revenue of R$2,871.8M was up 20.3% y/y and up 8.3% q/q; net income rose 33.5% y/y with net margin up 5.1ppt to 51.4%.
summary_long: Revenue reached R$2,871.8M, up 20.3% y/y and 8.3% q/q. Gross margin was 74.9% (+1.8ppt y/y, +1.3ppt q/q) and operating margin 67.1% (+2.6ppt y/y, +2.9ppt q/q). Net margin rose to 51.4%, up 5.1ppt y/y and 17.2ppt q/q. EPS was R$0.88, up 39.1% y/y and 63.7% q/q; diluted EPS R$0.88, up 38.9% y/y. Net income of R$1,477.0M rose 33.5% y/y and 62.7% q/q. EBITDA of R$2,583.0M rose 25.3% y/y but fell 26.8% q/q; EBIT similarly fell 27.5% q/q despite a 26.7% y/y gain. No cash-position figure is available on the shard.

EBITDA and EBIT declined q/q despite rising y/y; the release was not read, so no cause is asserted for that divergence.
